shape.pivot: centre of one horizontal brushstroke, with positive length axis toward the leader

visual_inputs_proposed.formationCompletion: Finite 0...1 visual completion from SpeciesAbilityState.completion. Playback duration around 2 s is already governed by game state.
visual_inputs_proposed.formationState: Game-provided loose, forming, formed, releasing or broken event. Current activation is a feather-button toggle. Game code owns trigger semantics and sharp-turn threshold.
visual_inputs_proposed.heading: Current horizontal leader heading for orientation and outward direction.
visual_inputs_proposed.slotsBySide: Game-provided world anchors partitioned by wing and sorted nearest-to-farthest from leader, with height and assigned follower validity. May use current body poses to avoid drawing an ideal V over a departing bird.
visual_inputs_proposed.terrainHeight: Site surface height or min-safe visual guide plane in the same units as slot anchors.
visual_inputs_proposed.opacityScale: Optional finite 0...1 art/accessibility multiplier. Default 1. Can be set to 0 to hide.

material.ink: warm gray-gold, soft ends and clear 1 px texture border
material.realitykit: Validate UnlitMaterial or an equivalent shader with texture-driven alpha. No bloom or additive blend required.

placement.eligibility: Pair consecutive valid anchors on each wing. Skip any gap with a missing rank, coincident or nonfinite position; require at least two valid adjacent anchors on that wing.
placement.pivot_formula: centroid(anchorA,anchorB) + side * horizontalLeaderRight * outsideOffset; clamp displayed height to at least sampled terrain+clearance
placement.orientation: Point local +Y (GLB -Z) toward the near anchor along the gap, preserve world up.
placement.length_formula: horizontal gap length * dashFillRatio; map to 0.64 BU mesh before instancing. Width is independently controlled.
placement.release: Keep last valid route for the fade or continue updating only still-eligible anchors. Cut when an anchor no longer exists.
placement.drawLayer: Depth test against opaque birds and terrain. Runtime transparent layer ordering awaits RealityKit verification.

envelope.note: All timing knobs are visual candidate settings. Formation gameplay stays in Swift. Review timing and bird poses are in .blend, while GLB contains the single static dab.
